meta: Write video titles and make thumbnails with AI: clickable without clickbait, so viewers don't feel tricked.

muc.title: Sensational, then gone
muc.text: Sensational titles get clicks, but viewers who feel tricked scroll away and never come back.

muc.title: Words people actually type
muc.text: Ask a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, how viewers search for this topic, then put the keywords at the start of the title.

muc.title: Deliver what you promise
muc.text: Ask AI for ten titles, then cross out any that promise more than the video actually delivers.

muc.title: Few words, one expression
muc.text: A thumbnail should have just a few big words and one expressive face. Ask AI to cut the title to under six words.

muc.title: Ten titles
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for ten titles for your latest video, then pick one that's both clear and honest.

thu: Ask a chatbot for 10 titles for your latest video, then pick one that's both clear and honest.
